title: Retinal Vascular Permeability Protocol
author: David A. Antonetti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yagfsbw
materials: Anesthetize the animal again with ketamine/xylazine

steps.title: Prepare Animal and Isolate Femoral Vein
steps.instruction: Weigh the animal and record body weight for anesthetic and dye injections. Make an incision on the skin inside of the hind leg and carefully tear away the membranes to isolate the femoral vein.

steps.title: Inject FITC-BSA
steps.instruction: Inject FITC-BSA into the femoral vein at 2 µl/g body weight (equal to 200 mg/kg body weight) using a 31-gauge 0.3 c.c. insulin syringe.

steps.title: Post-Injection Care
steps.instruction: Apply pressure on the injection site with a sterile gauze or cotton swab to stop bleeding, staple the incision site, and allow FITC-BSA to circulate for 2 hours.

steps.title: Collect Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Open the abdomen and draw 0.3 ml blood from the vena cava with a 27-gauge 1 c.c. syringe.

substeps.instruction: Remove needle and expel blood into a heparinized micro-cuvette
Mix blood sample by gently reversing the tube several times and keep on ice

steps.title: Perfuse and Harvest Retina
steps.instruction: Open the chest cavity and cannulate the heart with a blunt end 22-gauge needle into the left ventricle, then incise the right atrium to release pressure.

substeps.instruction: Perfuse with saline (warmed to 37°C) at 20 ml/min via the left ventricle for 2 minutes
Harvest the retina and place in a pre-weighed microcentrifuge tube
Rinse harvest tools between samples to avoid cross contamination

steps.title: Process Blood Plasma
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the blood sample at 2,000 x g at 20°C for 15 minutes to separate plasma.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the plasma to a new microcentrifuge tube and store at -80°C

steps.title: Prepare Retina Samples
steps.instruction: Dry the retina samples with a Speed-Vac overnight.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the microcentrifuge tube containing the dry retina to obtain the dry retina weight

steps.title: Extract FITC-BSA from Retina
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of 1% Triton-PBS to each retina and shake overnight to extract FITC-BSA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the microcentrifuge tubes at 17,000 x g for 30 minutes
Transfer supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: Prepare Standards and Dilutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the samples and standards for measurement.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the plasma samples with 1% Triton-PBS
Dilute the stock FITC-BSA (100 mg/ml) with 1% Triton-PBS and make serial dilutions to obtain the FITC-BSA standards

steps.title: Measure Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure the standards (0.156 to 10 µg/ml), retina extract, and diluted (1:900) plasma samples in a 384-well black/clear bottom plate using a fluorescent plate reader (excitation 488 nm, emission 520 nm).

steps.title: Calculate FITC-BSA Concentration
steps.instruction: Calculate the FITC-BSA concentration of each sample using the standard curve.

substeps.instruction: Subtract the auto-fluorescence background of the retina from an animal without FITC-BSA injection for the permeability calculation
